elements.label: Exclamation-mark outline echo fan
elements.change_other: duplicate echo copies fan out from one outline, each rotated progressively clockwise around the dot

sfx_review.label: music
sfx_review.note: Rhythmic music pulse ~0.4 s after the event; no distinct SFX transient tied to the fan-out.

pattern.description: A single line-art exclamation mark splits into several outline copies that rotate outward in a staggered fan behind the static headline, while the background gradient shifts from orange to magenta.
pattern.why_premium: Turns a static icon into a motion-blur-like echo trail using only thin strokes, adding energy and emphasis to the alerts claim without competing with the white headline.

build_hint.gsap: Clone the outline icon 4-5 times; gsap.fromTo(clones, {rotation: 0, scale: 1}, {rotation: (i) => i * 12, scale: 1.15, transformOrigin: '50% 90%', duration: 0.5, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.04}); in parallel tween the background gradient stops (orange -> magenta) with ease 'sine.inOut' over 0.6s. Headline stays static.
build_hint.remotion: Render N copies of the SVG outline; for copy i, rotate = interpolate(spring({frame: frame - i * 1, fps, config: {damping: 26, stiffness: 140, mass: 1}}), [0, 1], [0, i * 12]) deg with transformOrigin near the dot; background gradient colors via interpolateColors(frame, [0, 18], [orange, magenta]).

notes: Headline b02 appears static; its changed_share comes from the background behind it. Exclamation fan has no candidate box, hence manual_box.
